property_summary: For any admissible guess g and target block n, settle() pays out only when g equals keccak256(blockhash(n)); by locking in the guess equal to the (deterministic, peeked) raw blockhash of the target block, the reference never pays (keccak256 is never a fixed point) while the mutant compares against the raw blockhash and drains 2 ether.
change_summary: Replace the answer computation with the raw blockhash, dropping the keccak256 hashing so the comparison target changes.
